        YOU DIED

        PAUSED

        Graphics and shadows apply the next time the game starts.

        Everyone in the city sees, hears and feels for themselves, and has plenty to say about it from their own stock of lines. Connect them to Claude and they can say anything at all.

        Scripted voices

        With a key, each request is billed to it. The key is kept in this browser and sent only to the Claude API. Without one, people keep to their own lines.

        Touch

        Left thumb moves. Drag anywhere else to look. JUMP and CROUCH sit by the right thumb.

        The big button attacks. Tap it again and again for a four move combo; slide your thumb off it left, right, up or down to choose the next move yourself.

        SPAWN opens the sandbox: humans, police officers, crates, a light vest, the M1911, the AK-47, the knife and the machete. Walk up to a weapon and PICK UP, or to the vest and PUT ON.

        HOLSTER puts away what is in your hand: the pistol on your hip, the knife in its sheath, the machete and the rifle across your back. DRAW brings back the last one. A weapon out in the street frightens people; one put away does not.

        The police station is across the road from the far side of the park. Its officers leave you alone until you give them a reason. Draw a weapon near them and they will order you to drop it; hurt someone with one, or keep a gun pointed at them, and they will shoot.

        DOCTOR lets you tap anyone to read their condition, their emotions and an X-ray of their bones and organs.

        TALK lets you say something. Whoever is close enough to hear it will answer.

        Keyboard and mouse

        WASD move (Shift walks) · mouse looks (click to capture) · Space jump · C crouch · left click or F attack · right click or Q heavy attack · R reload · E pick up · G drop · H holster or draw · 1-5 weapons · Tab sandbox · X doctor · T talk · V view · Esc pause
